source_note: Money evidence uses seller prices. Cases follow on 778–787. All competitor/AI work is second-pass uncounted. No new outreach, payment or building. Lower ticket deliberately included to test low-economics negative.

cases.payer: UK homeowner with an architectural sketch/dimensioned plans
cases.paid_outcome: remote 3D home model and screenshots from existing dimensioned drawings
cases.spend_capture_test: A digital 3D modelling service is sold without physical survey; human designer supplies geometry interpretation and feedback
cases.inputs_and_accepted_output: Architect plans + material preferences -> plausible scale-accurate 3D model and view exports
cases.verification_oracle: Visual and dimensional approval by homeowner/designer; no machine oracle for missing measurements
cases.AI_repeated: General AI visualizes concepts, but accuracy to original dimensions and revision approval not reliable
cases.AI_built: AI-built 3D scene generation lacks geometry fidelity unless expert models each input
cases.first_ten_access: Homeowner planning communities accessible, no validated ten buying model-only
cases.second_kill: One-off low-recurrence £600 creative service vs CAD human hours and frequent design changes
cases.next_attack: Only reconsider if validated fully digital exact modelling without human editing

cases.payer: UK family genealogist with old manuscript records
cases.spend_capture_test: Customers separately buy complete transcriptions, but handwriting expert verification dominates price
cases.inputs_and_accepted_output: Clear JPEG/PDF of record -> verified transcription with marked illegible spans and original line alignment
cases.verification_oracle: Transcription can be manually compared character-by-character; no authoritative oracle for unreadable handwriting
cases.AI_repeated: General AI and specialised HTR can attempt common scripts, but older abbreviations require specialist review
cases.AI_built: Automated handwriting recognition existing; quality exception workload falls on founder
cases.first_ten_access: UK genealogy associations, no ten proven payment interest for independent AI
cases.second_kill: Low hourly fee buys paleography; automated guesses damage trust and require editorial QA
cases.next_attack: Do not infer €500 genealogy spend transfers to transcript app

cases.trigger: audio piece needs musician-readable notation for performance
cases.paid_outcome: ear-transcribed notated score and instrumental parts
cases.spend_capture_test: Printed score is independently paid digital output, but ear transcription, rhythm ambiguity and orchestrating remain professional
cases.inputs_and_accepted_output: Owned recording/MIDI -> correctly articulated MusicXML/PDF score usable for rehearsal
cases.verification_oracle: Playback comparison possible but not accepted proof of right voice separation, rhythms, expression
cases.AI_repeated: Pitch/rhythm transcription AI already available; polyphonic accuracy uncertain
cases.AI_built: AI-build resembles existing transcription engines, human correction is real bought result
cases.first_ten_access: Musician/music teacher communities available, ten verified buyers absent
cases.second_kill: Specialist ear training plus existing software, and prior choir rehearsal-track kill remain distinct but reinforcing
cases.next_attack: No standalone complete AI score with proven acceptance

cases.paid_outcome: done-for-you designed and physically printed photo book
cases.spend_capture_test: The full purchase buys photo curation, premium physical print, personalised delivery and taste; an automated PDF would be only a feature
cases.inputs_and_accepted_output: Customer photos -> curated layout -> printed and shipped durable album
cases.verification_oracle: Visual preferences subjective; physical QC/printing and logistics indispensable
cases.AI_repeated: LLM and photo sorting can draft pages; no physical production
cases.AI_built: AI-built photo book layout trivial, but delivering same paid outcome needs print fulfillment
cases.first_ten_access: UK travel/wedding consumers reachable, no buyer selection evidence
cases.second_kill: Physical printing and bespoke curation are inseparable premium components; no low-touch product capture

cases.payer: UK hobby crocheter commissioning a picture pattern
cases.trigger: wants crochet graph with stitch counts from favorite image
cases.paid_outcome: custom c2c/single-crochet digital pattern with stitch instructions
cases.spend_capture_test: Digital design sold separately at low price; no consumer distribution economics for founder
cases.inputs_and_accepted_output: Owned image + gauge/colors -> stitch chart, yarn count and written instructions
cases.verification_oracle: Stitch chart and generated count rules deterministic; artistic colour simplification subjective
cases.AI_repeated: General AI/palette quantization can map image to grid repeatedly
cases.AI_built: Straightforward to build, which drives commoditization and low willingness to pay
cases.first_ten_access: Crochet groups findable, not ten paid early customers
cases.second_kill: £10 one-off and existing stitch chart builders make €5k MRR implausible without evidenced scale

cases.trigger: publish illustrated children's book from supplied story and images
cases.paid_outcome: print-ready interior, cover, publication and printed book package
cases.price: £575 for package including printing and cover
cases.spend_capture_test: A significant portion of fee buys publishing coordination, proofing, print and illustrator support; digital PDF layout not complete sold outcome
cases.inputs_and_accepted_output: Manuscript/illustrations -> proofed print-ready PDF + proof/physical book distribution
cases.verification_oracle: Bleed/font checks measurable but visual arrangement and actual print proof not fully machine verified
cases.AI_repeated: General AI can propose layout; production typography, font rights and printer proof remain
cases.AI_built: Print PDF workflow possible but low-cost publishing products and previous EPUB kill overlap; no new unique advantage
cases.first_ten_access: Self-publishers direct channels, no independent purchase for partial software
cases.second_kill: Package wraps print and creative service; earlier accessible EPUB kill stands; not a fresh product
cases.next_attack: Do not reopen generic eBook formatting

cases.payer: UK estate agent with a listing deadline tomorrow
cases.trigger: sketch floor plan must be listing-ready in 24h not 48h
cases.paid_outcome: express digitally redrawn marketing floor plan
cases.price: standard from £18, express +50% (thus £9+ incremental for base tier)
cases.spend_capture_test: Express turnaround sold as paid add-on, but a separate entrant would need to capture £9 premium from incumbents and improve quality
cases.inputs_and_accepted_output: Photo/sketch + dimensions -> accurate floor plan PNG/PDF in 24h and amendments
cases.verification_oracle: Vector and dimension consistency checks can validate simple cases; missing dimensions still human
cases.AI_repeated: General multimodal AI can draft redrawings, but ambiguous measurement requires checks
cases.AI_built: Automated redraw services and £5–£18 human providers already cover
cases.first_ten_access: Estate agencies reachable but transaction fee too low and source-data errors high
cases.second_kill: Actual convenience premium £9 per small property; zero structural room for new SaaS
cases.next_attack: Do not equate speed premium to enterprise MRR

cases.payer: UK recording artist on fixed release date
cases.trigger: needs final stereo master before scheduled upload
cases.paid_outcome: priority engineer mastering within around 48h vs queue
cases.price: £25 surcharge per single, £45 EP, £80 album on top of from £60 single
cases.spend_capture_test: Premium buys a qualified engineer's availability and revisions, not machine processing speed alone
cases.inputs_and_accepted_output: Approved final mix -> human-reviewed WAV/DDP release master
cases.verification_oracle: Audio specs/loudness checks available; mix quality and mastering taste require listening
cases.AI_repeated: AI mastering services already process in minutes for lower price; premium chooses human ear
cases.AI_built: AI mastering trivially accessible, high-end service cannot be automated at same standard
cases.first_ten_access: Musicians via UK labels, ten exact rushed payers not shown
cases.second_kill: What customers pay extra for is priority human engineer time and accountability
cases.next_attack: Never claim £80 album priority is monetizable SaaS budget

cases.payer: UK architecture studio with accelerated planning/marketing milestone
cases.trigger: requires CGI render in 2–3 days rather than 5–7 days
cases.price: 30–50% rush premium over standard quote; base indicative £350
cases.spend_capture_test: Published extra fee, but no separately paid fast renderer proven and approval of full 3D model materials is labour-intensive
cases.inputs_and_accepted_output: Architect CAD/Revit + material brief -> professionally approved camera-accurate CGI image
cases.verification_oracle: Basic image format measurable; exact material/context fidelity and style subjective
cases.AI_repeated: Image AI gets quick concepts, repeated accurate CAD-to-final renders still need operator review
cases.AI_built: AI-built high-fidelity render pipelines still require handling bespoke materials and client approvals
cases.first_ten_access: Architecture practices directory, no ten contracts or switching cases
cases.second_kill: Premium pays studio scheduling and manual revisions; a quick render function is not accepted CGI
cases.next_attack: No evidential separation of rush paid outcome

cases.payer: UK artist/print seller needing digitised original urgently
cases.trigger: gallery submission or art print deadline
cases.paid_outcome: two-hour artwork scanning and corrected digital master files
cases.price: £50 extra priority charge for up to 2 artworks, on top of scanning
cases.spend_capture_test: Paid service requires physical capture of originals using calibrated scanner and operator; software cannot scan unprovided artwork
cases.verification_oracle: Resolution/ICC colour verification possible only after calibration and physical capture
cases.AI_repeated: AI can optimize uploaded scans but cannot perform physical calibrated capture
cases.AI_built: AI photo upscaling is partial substitute; no independent equivalent of full sold job
cases.first_ten_access: Artists and giclee shops reachable but physical shop delivery essential
cases.second_kill: Rush money buys physical equipment access and queue priority; outside software scope
cases.next_attack: Do not revive as photo filter
